description: Admin/executive console: shell, member management, event management with offline attendance capture, certificate management, opportunities review queue, gallery management, and settings. This is the most complex FEAT. The offline attendance capture (IndexedDB + background sync) is P0 — the highest-risk item in Phase 1. All admin routes require EXECUTIVE or ADMIN role (from FEAT-001). Independent of FEAT-002 (public routes).
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001's findings field before starting. Read src/app/(member)/layout.tsx and src/components/member/member-shell.tsx as the pattern to follow for the admin shell.

Read docs/design/screens/12-exec-overview.html (first 200 lines), 13-exec-members.html (first 150 lines), 14-exec-attendance.html (first 200 lines), 15-exec-certificates.html (first 150 lines) to understand the intended admin UI layout.

Create src/components/admin/admin-nav-items.ts: export const ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS array with { href, label, icon } for: /admin/overview (LayoutDashboardIcon, 'Overview'), /admin/members (UsersIcon, 'Members'), /admin/events (CalendarIcon, 'Events'), /admin/certificates (AwardIcon, 'Certificates'), /admin/opportunities (BriefcaseIcon, 'Opportunities'), /admin/gallery (ImageIcon, 'Gallery'), /admin/settings (SettingsIcon, 'Settings'). Use lucide-react icons.

Create src/components/admin/admin-shell.tsx: 'use client' — handles sidebar collapse. Props: fullName, roles, children. Left sidebar: collapsed at <1024px (icon-only) with toggle button, expanded at >=1024px. Sidebar items from ADMIN_NAV_ITEMS, active state from usePathname(). Top bar: NiMechE-SF brand mark (use BrandMark from src/components/brand-mark.tsx), user name, sign-out button (POST to /sign-out). Mobile: sidebar as a drawer overlay (use the Dialog or a CSS transform). Touch targets >=44px. Focus rings visible. Background var(--surface), borders var(--border). Text var(--text), active nav item bg var(--primary-subtle), active text var(--primary-text).

Create src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx: async server component. Calls requireRole([EXECUTIVE, ADMIN]) from src/lib/auth/roles.ts — this redirects non-admin users. Renders <AdminShell fullName={member.fullName} roles={roles}>{children}</AdminShell>.
Create src/app/(admin)/page.tsx: import redirect from next/navigation; export default function AdminRoot() { redirect('/admin/overview'); }

Create src/lib/admin/queries.ts: getAdminOverview() — parallel queries: totalMembers (Member.count), pendingMembers (Member.count where status=PENDING), activeMembers (Member.count where status=ACTIVE), upcomingEvents (Event.count where status=PUBLISHED and startsAt>=now), totalCredentials (Credential.count where revokedAt=null), openOpportunities (Opportunity.count where status=published), recentAuditLog (AuditLog.findMany last 10, include actor.fullName). Returns all as a single object.

Create src/app/(admin)/overview/page.tsx: calls getAdminOverview(). Renders: stat tiles row (Members, Pending, Events, Certificates — use Card components), pending members alert (if pendingMembers > 0, show orange alert card with link to /admin/members?status=pending), upcoming events strip (list of next 3 events), recent audit log list (actor name, action label, timestamp). Follow 12-exec-overview.html layout.

Create src/lib/members/admin.ts: getMemberList(filter?) — queries Member with optional search on fullName/email/matricNo, optional status filter, optional department filter, ordered by createdAt desc, no pagination (flat list per DEV_PLAN 2.4 — hundreds of rows). getMemberDetail(id) — full row plus MemberRole+Role, plus last 5 ActivityEntry, plus Credential count. approveMember(actorId, memberId, matricNo?) — sets status=ACTIVE, joinedAt=now(), optionally sets matricNo and memberNo (generated as 'SF-TECHU-' + zero-padded count); logAudit; calls sendMemberApprovalEmail. rejectMember(actorId, memberId) — sets status=LAPSED; logAudit. updateMemberRoleAdmin(actorId, memberId, roleKey, grant) — calls grantRole or revokeRole from src/lib/auth/roles.ts.
Extend src/lib/email.ts with: sendMemberApprovalEmail(to: string, name: string) — plain text email telling the member their account is approved and they can now sign in at [siteUrl('/sign-in')].

Create src/app/(admin)/members/page.tsx: calls getMemberList(filter from URL params). Renders a table (use Table/TableHeader/TableBody/TableRow/TableCell from src/components/ui/table.tsx): columns are Name, Email, Department, Level, Status, Joined, Actions. Status filter tabs: All | Pending | Active | Lapsed. Search input (URL param ?search=, submits on Enter or after debounce — use a client component SearchInput that updates URL params). Each row's action: link to /admin/members/[id]. Pending rows highlighted with var(--accent-subtle) background.

Create src/app/(admin)/members/[id]/page.tsx: calls getMemberDetail(params.id). Renders: member header (name, email, status badge, department, level, joined date), credentials count, recent activity list. Action section: if status=PENDING, show Approve button (with optional matricNo field) and Reject button. If status=ACTIVE, show role management section (list current roles, add/remove EXECUTIVE role button). Buttons trigger server actions via forms. Follow 13-exec-members.html layout.

Create src/app/(admin)/members/actions.ts: 'use server'. approveMemberAction(memberId, matricNo?), rejectMemberAction(memberId), updateRoleAction(memberId, roleKey, grant) — all call requireRole([EXECUTIVE, ADMIN]) then the corresponding admin.ts function. Use revalidatePath('/admin/members') after mutations.

Create src/lib/events/admin.ts: getAdminEventList() — all events any status, ordered startsAt desc. createEvent(actorId, data) — validates with eventSchema (Zod), creates Event row status=DRAFT, logAudit. updateEvent(actorId, eventId, data) — updates mutable fields, logAudit. publishEvent(actorId, eventId) — status=PUBLISHED, logAudit. cancelEvent(actorId, eventId) — status=CANCELLED, logAudit. completeEvent(actorId, eventId) — status=COMPLETED, logAudit, then calls runCompletionEvaluation(eventId) from src/lib/credentials/completions.ts. getEventWithAttendance(eventId) — event + registered members list (Registration join Member) + attended member ids (AttendanceRecord).

Create src/lib/validation/event.ts: Zod schema eventSchema — z.object({ title: z.string().min(3).max(200), kind: z.enum([...EventKind values]), startsAt: z.string() (ISO datetime), endsAt: z.string().optional(), mode: z.enum([...EventMode values]), location: z.string().max(200).optional(), host: z.string().max(100).optional(), capacity: z.coerce.number().int().positive().optional(), contactHours: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).default(0), notes: z.string().max(500).optional(), completionRuleId: z.string().optional() }).

Create src/app/(admin)/events/page.tsx: calls getAdminEventList(). Table with columns: Title, Kind, Date, Status badge, Registered, Attended, Actions (Edit | Attendance | View). Status badge colours: DRAFT=neutral, PUBLISHED=primary, CANCELLED=danger, COMPLETED=muted. 'New event' button links to /admin/events/new.

Create src/app/(admin)/events/new/page.tsx: event creation form. Uses react-hook-form + eventSchema. Fields in one screen (not a wizard): Title, Kind (segmented buttons using src/components/segmented-field.tsx pattern), Date+time (starts_at, ends_at), Mode (buttons: In Person | Online | Hybrid), Location/Meeting URL (conditional on mode), Capacity (optional), Contact Hours, Host name (optional), Notes (optional). Submit calls createEventAction. On success, redirect to /admin/events/[id].

Create src/app/(admin)/events/[id]/page.tsx: calls getEventWithAttendance(params.id). Shows: event header (title, date, kind, status), stat tiles (registered, attended, capacity), action buttons (Publish / Cancel / Complete — conditional on current status), quick links to Edit and Attendance screens. Registered vs attended diff visible ('12 registered, 9 attended').
Create src/app/(admin)/events/[id]/edit/page.tsx: pre-populated form reusing eventSchema and the same form component as /new, but with PUT semantics. Calls updateEventAction.

Create src/app/(admin)/events/actions.ts: 'use server'. createEventAction, updateEventAction, publishEventAction, cancelEventAction, completeEventAction — all call requireRole([EXECUTIVE, ADMIN]) then admin.ts functions. revalidatePath after each mutation.

Create src/lib/email.ts additions: sendEventRegistrationEmail(to: string, name: string, eventTitle: string, startsAt: Date) — tells member they are registered, includes date+time formatted with date-fns.

Create src/app/(admin)/events/[id]/attendance/page.tsx: server component. Calls getEventWithAttendance(params.id) to get the event header and the full registered member list. Passes data as JSON to the client component. Export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' (attendance list changes in real time).

Create src/components/admin/attendance-capture.tsx: 'use client'. This is the offline-capable attendance screen. Implementation details: (1) On mount, open IndexedDB database 'nimeche-attendance' with object stores: 'members' (full member list, keyed by id) and 'queue' (pending sync items, auto-increment key). Use the native IDB API (no extra package) wrapped in Promise helpers. (2) Write all registered members to the 'members' store on mount. (3) State: members array (from IDB), checkedIn Set<string> (memberIds), queue array, isOnline boolean, syncing boolean. (4) Search input: filters members by fullName or matricNo in real time (no network call — filtering the local IDB-cached list). (5) Check-in button for each member: generates clientEventId via crypto.randomUUID(), immediately marks member as checked-in in UI, writes item { memberId, clientEventId, checkedInAt: new Date().toISOString(), eventId } to the 'queue' store. (6) Online/offline banner at top: 'X check-ins queued, waiting for connection' (orange, var(--accent-text)) when queue > 0; 'All synced' (green) when queue empty. (7) Sync function: reads all queue items, POSTs to /api/events/[eventId]/attendance/bulk, on success removes synced items from queue store. (8) Auto-sync: useEffect with navigator.onLine listener (window online/offline events) + setInterval every 30s. (9) Walk-in section (separate tab): name search + 'Check in walk-in' button that both registers and checks in a member not in the list. (10) All UI uses CSS variables only (var(--primary), var(--surface), etc.). Touch targets >=44px. Props: eventId, eventTitle, registeredMembers (array passed from server), initialAttended (set of memberIds already in AttendanceRecord).

Create src/app/api/events/[id]/attendance/bulk/route.ts: export async function POST(request, { params }). Auth check: call auth() from src/auth.ts, verify session.user.isAdmin (from JWT). Body: { records: Array<{ memberId: string, clientEventId: string, checkedInAt: string }> }. Upsert logic: use db.attendanceRecord.createMany({ data: records.map(...), skipDuplicates: true }) — Prisma createMany with skipDuplicates handles the clientEventId unique constraint. Also, for any memberId not already registered, create a Registration row first (walk-in). Returns { processed: number, skipped: number }.

Create src/lib/credentials/completions.ts: runCompletionEvaluation(eventId: string). Fetches the event with its completionRule (null = ATTENDANCE_ONLY). Fetches all AttendanceRecord rows for the event. For each attendance record: checks if ActivityCompletion already exists (skip if so); checks completion rule (ATTENDANCE_ONLY: always complete; ATTENDANCE_PLUS_DELIVERABLE: check Deliverable.submittedAt IS NOT NULL; MANUAL_APPROVAL: skip, requires explicit approval). Creates ActivityCompletion rows for qualifying members. Returns { completed: number }.

Create src/lib/credentials/issuance.ts: generateVerificationCode() — generates a 9-char code format 'NM-XXXX-XXXX' from alphabet 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789' (no 0/O/1/I), checks for collision in Credential table, retries up to 5 times. issueCredentialsForEvent(actorId: string, eventId: string): finds ActivityCompletion rows for event where no Credential exists yet (LEFT JOIN check); for each, generates code, creates Credential row (title from event title, sessions=1, contactHours from event), creates CredentialEvent row, creates ActivityEntry (CERTIFICATE_ISSUED), logAudit; fires sendCertificateIssuedEmail; returns { issued: number }. revokeCredential(actorId: string, credentialId: string, reason: string): sets revokedAt=now(), logAudit; returns void.

Extend src/lib/email.ts with: sendCertificateIssuedEmail(to: string, name: string, credentialTitle: string, verificationCode: string, verifyUrl: string) — plain text email telling member their certificate for [credentialTitle] has been issued, includes the verification code and the verify URL.

Create src/app/(admin)/certificates/page.tsx: calls db.credential.findMany (via a helper in src/lib/admin/queries.ts — add getCertificateList()) with member name, title, issuedAt, revokedAt, code. Table with columns: Member, Certificate, Issued, Code, Status. 'Issue certificates' section: select an event from completed events, button 'Issue for this event' calls issueCertificatesAction. Revoke button per row opens confirmation Dialog. Follow 15-exec-certificates.html.
Create src/app/(admin)/certificates/actions.ts: 'use server'. issueCertificatesAction(eventId), revokeCredentialAction(credentialId, reason) — both require EXECUTIVE/ADMIN role.

Create src/app/(admin)/opportunities/page.tsx: two-tab view (shadcn Tabs from src/components/ui/tabs.tsx): 'Review Queue' tab shows SUBMITTED + UNDER_REVIEW items with Publish and Reject buttons; 'Published' tab shows PUBLISHED items. Each item shows title, org, type badge, deadline, submitted date. Publish/Reject call server actions.

Create src/app/(admin)/opportunities/actions.ts: 'use server'. publishOpportunityAction(id), rejectOpportunityAction(id, reason) — require EXECUTIVE/ADMIN, call src/lib/opportunities/queries.ts functions.

Create src/lib/gallery/upload.ts: createAlbum(actorId, data: { title, description?, eventId? }) — creates Album row with slug generated from title, returns album. addMediaItem(actorId, albumId, blobUrl, altText, width?, height?) — creates MediaItem row. publishAlbum(actorId, albumId) — sets publishedAt=now(), logAudit.

Create src/app/api/gallery/upload/route.ts: POST. Auth: EXECUTIVE/ADMIN only. Accepts multipart/form-data: file (image/jpeg|png|webp, max 10MB), albumId (string), altText (string, required). Uses @vercel/blob put() to upload file to Blob storage. Then calls addMediaItem(). Returns { url, itemId }. Validate file type and size, return 400 for violations.

Create src/app/(admin)/gallery/page.tsx: calls getPublishedAlbums() + unpublished albums (add getAdminAlbumList() to src/lib/gallery/queries.ts). Renders album list with cover, title, published status, photo count, event link. 'New album' button.
Create src/app/(admin)/gallery/new/page.tsx: form with title, description, linked event (select from published events). Submit calls createAlbumAction server action.

Create src/components/admin/photo-upload.tsx: 'use client'. Props: albumId. Renders a file drop zone (accept image/*, multiple). On drop/select: iterates files, for each shows a preview (FileReader + ), requires user to fill in altText input, then POSTs to /api/gallery/upload with FormData. Progress indicator per file. Error handling (size > 10MB, wrong type). On upload success, calls onSuccess callback to refresh the photo grid.

Create src/app/(admin)/gallery/[id]/page.tsx: server component. Fetches album with MediaItems. Renders: album header (title, linked event, published status, Publish button if not yet published). Photo grid (responsive, use CSS grid). PhotoUpload client component below the grid. Each existing photo: thumbnail, alt text, delete button (calls deleteMediaItemAction).

Create src/app/(admin)/settings/page.tsx: ADMIN role only (requireRole([ADMIN])). Displays current environment-based settings as read-only: branch name, contact email, session target, environment. Includes instructions for where to update these (update .env file). No DB writes in Phase 1.
Run npm run typecheck and fix all TypeScript errors. Run npm run build and fix all build errors.
acceptance_criteria: A MEMBER role user visiting /admin is redirected to /me
/admin/overview renders stat tiles and pending member alert
/admin/members renders member list with search and status filter
/admin/members/[id] renders member detail with approve/reject buttons
Approving a member sets status=ACTIVE and fires the approval email (printed to console in dev)
/admin/events/new renders a single-screen event creation form
Checking in a member with DevTools offline mode still marks them in the UI immediately
When back online, queued check-ins sync to the /api/events/[id]/attendance/bulk endpoint
/admin/certificates renders certificate list with issue and revoke actions
/admin/opportunities renders review queue with publish/reject buttons
/admin/gallery renders album management with photo upload
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
npm run build succeeds with zero errors
verification: npm run typecheck (must pass with zero errors)
npm run test (existing tests must still pass)
